mpv (recommended) has the widest format support — DTS/TrueHD audio, unusual files — plus the A/V sync fix. ExoPlayer plays some streams mpv can\'t on certain TVs, but can\'t decode DTS/TrueHD audio and has no A/V sync fix. The combined options try the other player automatically when the first one fails; the single-player options never do, which saves a few seconds of black screen if the second player never works on your TV.

ExoPlayer (recommended) opens channels much faster and is the only one with live subtitles. mpv plays channels ExoPlayer can\'t, including some with unusual audio. The combined options try the other player automatically when the first one fails; the single-player options never do, which saves a few seconds of black screen if the second player never works on your TV. A channel you switch by hand in the player keeps your choice either way.
